title: Relax and Rock and Roll
description:
Enjoy the true Nashville experience at Relax and Rock and Roll. Where you can jam in the music room and soak in the hot tub. Then enjoy live music down the street and the greatest Italian restaurant in  Nashville only 2 miles away! It is within walking distance to Old Hickory lake and conveniently located near many shopping centers.  In addition, it is only a 15-minute drive to the Nashville airport and 20-minute drive to downtown Nashville.

Located in a quiet, safe neighborhood.
